summary: Phase 3 stat lines. Monthly Awards: works. /api/world/report awards picks each have a valid 'line'. GK picks show games, clean sheets, saves and rating. DEF picks show games, tackles won, interceptions and rating, with goals/assists only when non-zero. Attacker and U21 picks follow the MID or ATT rule. Rating has 1 decimal, labels are singular for 1, and no CA/PA appears. The UI world-award-{k}-{i}-line shows the line with mono numbers (12 of 12), and the old 'N min' text is gone. Breakout: 2 defects. (1) The Home card still shows 'Season grade 57.2, the best season among his teammates.' (2) The Breakout line uses the wrong position: Luca Romano is D (C) but gets the CM line ('13 games · 0 goals · 0 assists · 6.8 avg rating'), and the same applies to the auto_breakout notice text. Regression: world-news stories render (6 stat lines). 390px mobile has no horizontal overflow on Reports or Home.

critical.issue: season_line() calls GROUP[first_pos(x)], but x comes from own_contexts(), which has no 'positions' list. It only has 'position' (already a group code like 'CB'). first_pos falls back to FALLBACK_POS 'M (C)', so every Breakout winner gets the CM line. Luca Romano (positions ['D (C)','D (R)']) shows games/goals/assists/rating, with 0 goals and 0 assists shown. The CB rule should give games, tackles won, interceptions and rating, with goals/assists only if any. A GK winner would get goals/assists instead of clean sheets/saves.

minor.issue: The empty-line guard only drops the line when 'games' is '0'. stat_line('ST',0,0,0,None,{}) returns '0 games · 0 goals · 0 assists' instead of []. This doesn't happen today because awards and stories need minutes and a rating, but it's worth tightening.

ui_bugs.issue:
Still shows '{c.note}, the best season among his teammates.' and c.note = 'Season grade 57.2' (stored by auto_breakout via _award(..., f"Season grade {w['grade']}")). The spec says no 'Season grade N' text on the card. Remove that

, or stop returning the note in /api/celebrations.

issues: The Breakout card's right edge looks about 16px inside the section's padding compared with the other cards (minor)

action_items: awards_api.season_line: get the group from the snapshot player's positions (p.get('positions')), or use x['position'] directly (it's already a group code like 'CB'). Don't use first_pos(x) on own_contexts entries. Then re-check that Luca Romano shows a CB line with no 0-goal/0-assist items.
Celebrations.jsx BreakoutCard: remove the c.note 'Season grade N, the best season among his teammates.' paragraph (or don't send the note from /api/celebrations).
Optional: auto_breakout audit text still says '(grade N)'. That's internal only, so OK to leave unless it's shown in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: season_line() has the position-group bug above; the same bug affects auto_breakout's notice body.

auto_breakout's notice text was changed correctly to 'Best season among your first-team players: <line>' (checked by code review). I did not trigger a season-end save read to avoid changing the career's data.
The main agent's note 'a CM breakout line may have no key passes' is based on this bug: the preview winner is a CB, not a CM.
